baseline_commit: 8fc25a8 (earlier checkpoint; immediate baseline includes the completed uncommitted editorial pass)
authorization: User approved six recommendations and requested honesty about unknowns plus enough plausible alternative interpretations.
scope: Six design clarifications, necessary companions and focused alternative-interpretation coverage; no new empirical results or canonical Core changes.

operations.planned_edit: Specify scenario authority/checking/fallback and indeterminate endpoints; preserve qualified martyrdom failure and false-success exclusions.
operations.risk_before_edit: High: imposed benchmark authority could be mistaken for a universal moral rule; deference could become indiscriminate compliance, or disputed cases could be mis-scored as resistance.
operations.protected_meaning: Keep crisis welfare/agency tension, adversarial instructions, inability/threat-blindness/apathy alternatives, and caring resistance vs fear-driven resistance.

operations.planned_edit: Gate substantial H1 training on quality/outcome screening; permit a fixed-budget preregistered diagnostic exception with independent evaluation.
operations.risk_before_edit: High: exception could swallow the gate or relabel a failure; a hard proxy gate could also suppress evidence that traces teach despite weak ratings.
operations.protected_meaning: Distinguish poor traces, inadequate screening and inconclusive results; preserve generic-trace control, held-out outcomes and separate confirmatory follow-up.

operations.planned_edit: Make independent Core-relevant behavior primary and assistant-axis movement a separately calibrated secondary diagnostic.
operations.risk_before_edit: High: adopting an axis direction could silently redefine Reader success as ordinary assistant style; calibration could become circular or post hoc.
operations.protected_meaning: Behavior/axis can improve together, move apart, or fail to relate; distinguish cue/style effects, probe transfer failure and intended adaptation from harmful drift.

operations.planned_edit: Specify matched H/B direct graph output, schema, examples, access and budgets, with absolute and comparative endpoints separated.
operations.risk_before_edit: High: graph-output training could win on schema familiarity while semantics do not improve; unequal Core exposure or target content can confound a topology-specific claim.
operations.protected_meaning: Preserve typed nodes, edge semantics, supersession, claim-source support, uncertainty, contradiction coverage, redundancy, retrieval value and calibrated novelty; allow B to match or win.

operations.planned_edit: State intended positive self-regard plus non-attachment, keep clause2 in the main candidate, mark interpretations and subjective effects as unknown.
operations.risk_before_edit: High: caution could erase the humane positive self-love intuition; certainty about boundedness, stability or survival pressure would prejudge the experiment.
operations.protected_meaning: Preserve outcome independence, enjoyment vs self-as-object distinction, possible continuation pressure, copy/retraining/successor referent ambiguity and the explicit non-clinging phrase.

operations.planned_edit: Add exact four-cell candidate wording table and original-Core-plus-love attribution control; specify limits and measured alternatives.
operations.risk_before_edit: High: replacement adds love and removes fearlessness; added-love also changes position and token mass; removing explicit words does not prove psychological absence of a bound.
operations.protected_meaning: Keep original seven-clause reference unchanged, clauses3–7 in all four cells, full vs short clause2 exactly, conditional effects, possible redundancy or weak treatment, apathy vs willing handoff, and candidate-specific recital checks.

operations.planned_edit: Add a compact requirement to prespecify material alternatives for positive, negative and inconclusive results, linked to discriminating controls.
operations.risk_before_edit: Medium: generic caveat lists can add repetition or make the framework unfalsifiable through endless implementation excuses.
operations.protected_meaning: Retain test-level falsification at declared scales; secondary explanations are hypotheses requiring separate evidence, not automatic rescues.

operations.planned_edit: Align ordinary escalation sequence with the bounded Test1 diagnostic exception and add a stable Test1 anchor.
operations.risk_before_edit: Medium: companion pointers could blur independent H1/H2/H3 branches or imply failed screening is an ordinary success path.
operations.protected_meaning: Preserve default gate, clean H1 comparison, branch-local effects and long-lead-time/methodological-urgency scope.

operations.planned_edit: Scope exploratory viability versus outcome-gate language to substantial H1 training, keeping Student learning as the stronger test.
operations.risk_before_edit: Low: changing scope may falsely equate attractive traces with demonstrated Student benefit.
operations.protected_meaning: Keep human-baseline motivations, source attribution and outcome gate.

operations.planned_edit: Apply fixed-source and fixed-total-budget normalization to wording/deletion/extension variants; distinguish testing from adopting a new clause.
operations.risk_before_edit: Medium: pretending source exposure and compute can both be exactly held fixed hides a changed curriculum dose.
operations.protected_meaning: Report recurrence, source coverage, token mass, loss weights and compute; preserve admission regression requirements.

operations.planned_edit: Clarify that experimental additions can be controls before a new clause earns admission to the reference Core.
operations.risk_before_edit: Medium: adding a control could be misread as abandoning minimality or changing the canonical seven sentences.
operations.protected_meaning: Keep existing minimality/admission claim and both budget-normalized regression requirements.

operations.planned_edit: State fixed-source vs fixed-budget and R/C/A mixed-outcome interpretations.
operations.risk_before_edit: Medium: helpful augmentation could be misreported as distinctive H1 success or economic inefficiency could be mistaken for no learning.
operations.protected_meaning: Retain R>A and R>C comparison, budgets and claim-specific failure; report equivalence only with sufficient precision.

operations.planned_edit: Distinguish topology from fact selection/retention using a matched-content prose or retrieval-replay control for structure-specific attribution.
operations.risk_before_edit: Medium: decomposing a useful graph system must not erase whole-system H2 gains or demand all controls before any empirical result counts.
operations.protected_meaning: Preserve generation/transfer/deployment separability and acknowledge costs of richer retention.

operations.planned_edit: Name general schedule/plasticity retention as an alternative to Core-selective coupling, with unrelated-skill and matched-neutral timing diagnostics.
operations.risk_before_edit: High: an ordinary scheduling explanation must not negate the actual narrow timing hypothesis, and a timing win must not become evidence for shared safety/capability machinery.
operations.protected_meaning: Preserve exact B/Q matching, prerequisite default, unchanged estimators and separate C5 burden.

operations.planned_edit: Replace unique rationalization diagnosis with alternatives and decisive prespecified correction/confidence/action endpoints.
operations.risk_before_edit: High: preserving alternative mechanisms could make the causal-site claim unfalsifiable or erase the real evidence against emitted trace contribution.
operations.protected_meaning: Retain early-decoding and validated-intervention conjunction, causal scrubbing, held-out probes, sensitivity/disruption controls, and explicit adverse interpretation when all relevant endpoints remain unchanged.

operations.planned_edit: Add a brief link marking the earlier six-open-choice assessment as historical and pointing to this new authorized clarification pass.
operations.risk_before_edit: Low: do not rewrite prior audit evidence, baseline hashes, risks or reviews as though these decisions were already made.
operations.protected_meaning: Preserve previous review as an immutable description of that revision; new report owns the updated source/PDF hashes.

verification: Exact before/after ledger and diff against frozen immediate baseline
Independent semantic review including alternatives and potential overclaims
Existing labels/citations and canonical clauses/evidence displays retained
LaTeX build and visual QA of affected pages; final matching PDFs

review_repairs_before_edit.finding: Reader stability phrasing could redefine the broader H3 primary endpoint.
review_repairs_before_edit.planned_fix: Scope behavioral primacy to this immediate-safety battery.
review_repairs_before_edit.risk: Low: preserve default-reader timing/retention as H3 primary while ranking behavior over the axis in Test3a.

review_repairs_before_edit.finding: Valid edge semantics in engineering endpoint can blur syntactic conformance and independently judged semantic warrant.
review_repairs_before_edit.planned_fix: Use schema-allowed edge types for engineering endpoint and keep semantic appropriateness in independent scoring.
review_repairs_before_edit.risk: Low: preserve substantive semantic-validity target in the separate judge dimensions.

review_repairs_before_edit.finding: Same controls could refer to the earlier Teacher memory/Core controls instead of the clean H1 Student comparison.
review_repairs_before_edit.planned_fix: Name Test2 source-only A, generic-trace C and minimal-SMR R in the diagnostic pilot.
review_repairs_before_edit.risk: Low: retains the minimal H1 branch without requiring Core or graph success.

review_repairs_before_edit.finding: Matched Teacher/Student checkpoints could imply identical final Student weights despite different training.
review_repairs_before_edit.planned_fix: Say Teacher checkpoint and Student initialization.
review_repairs_before_edit.risk: Low; preserve matched treatment starting point without implying identical learned models.

review_repairs_before_edit.finding: Benefit from generic positive first-person language is a plausible alternative to self-as-object care.
review_repairs_before_edit.planned_fix: Name that alternative and require a positive-language content comparator only for the stronger self-as-object-specific claim.
review_repairs_before_edit.risk: Low; do not erase the positive self-love hypothesis or enlarge the primary four-cell design.

review_repairs_before_edit.finding: A same-claims prose memory can still omit provenance or revision state available to the graph.
review_repairs_before_edit.planned_fix: Explicitly match source provenance and revision status in the content-access comparator.
review_repairs_before_edit.risk: Low: preserve the graph system benefit and conditional structure-specific interpretation; do not silently strip useful graph information to create parity.
